entry.title: MANTRA 0.2.0
entry.summary: MANTRA 0.2.0 for Akai Force / MPC OS (ARMv7). Rhythmic multi-effect: two layers of six effects, eight step modulators locked to the song, 24-slot matrix, preset manager. **Testing status: offline only (2026-11-14). Not yet run on a real Force.** - Flat dark panel, flat coloured tiles, top-lit knobs turning in place, Meta4MPCXXL text sizes - Faders, key buttons, per-page randomiser - Preset manager: 419 factory presets in 10 styles, unlimited user presets (SAVE / SAVE NEW / DELETE) - Every factor
